# 2NF / 3NF / BCNF 判定器（正反两组用例）
def closure(attrs, fds):
    res = set(attrs)
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        for lhs, rhs in fds:
            if lhs <= res and not rhs <= res:
                res |= rhs
                changed = True
    return res


def fmt(s):
    return "".join(sorted(s)) or "-"


def superkeys_candidates(attrs, fds):
    lst = sorted(attrs)
    n = len(lst)
    supers = []
    for mask in range(1, 1 << n):
        sub = frozenset(lst[i] for i in range(n) if mask >> i & 1)
        if closure(sub, fds) == set(attrs):
            supers.append(sub)
    cands = [s for s in supers if not any(o < s for o in supers)]
    key = lambda s: (len(s), fmt(s))
    return sorted(cands, key=key)


def proper_subsets(s):
    lst = sorted(s)
    n = len(lst)
    out = []
    for mask in range(1, (1 << n) - 1):
        out.append(frozenset(lst[i] for i in range(n) if mask >> i & 1))
    return out


def judge(attrs, fds):
    attrs = set(attrs)
    cands = superkeys_candidates(attrs, fds)
    prime = set()
    for c in cands:
        prime |= set(c)

    nf2, nf3, bcnf = True, True, True
    v2, v3, vb = [], [], []
    for lhs, rhs in fds:
        if rhs <= lhs:
            continue
        if closure(lhs, fds) != attrs:
            bcnf = False
            vb.append("%s->%s" % (fmt(lhs), fmt(rhs)))
            if not (set(rhs) - set(lhs)) <= prime:
                nf3 = False
                v3.append("%s->%s" % (fmt(lhs), fmt(rhs)))
    for c in cands:
        for sub in proper_subsets(set(c)):
            extra = closure(sub, fds) - prime
            if extra:
                nf2 = False
                v2.append("%s->%s (子集 of %s)" % (fmt(sub), fmt(extra), fmt(c)))
    return cands, prime, nf2, nf3, bcnf, v2, v3, vb


CASES = [
    ("C1 经典 3NF 但非 BCNF", {"A", "B", "C"},
     [(frozenset("AB"), frozenset("C")), (frozenset("C"), frozenset("B"))]),
    ("C2 2NF 但违反 3NF", {"Sno", "Sname", "Dept", "Dean"},
     [(frozenset(["Sno"]), frozenset(["Sname"])),
      (frozenset(["Sno"]), frozenset(["Dept"])),
      (frozenset(["Dept"]), frozenset(["Dean"]))]),
    ("C3 违反 2NF (部分依赖)", {"Sno", "Cno", "Grade", "Cname"},
     [(frozenset(["Sno", "Cno"]), frozenset(["Grade"])),
      (frozenset(["Cno"]), frozenset(["Cname"]))]),
    ("C4 满足 BCNF", {"A", "B", "C"},
     [(frozenset("A"), frozenset("B")), (frozenset("A"), frozenset("C"))]),
]

print("=== 范式判定器: 正反两组用例 ===")
print("%-22s %-14s %-6s %-6s %-6s" % ("关系", "候选键", "2NF", "3NF", "BCNF"))
for name, attrs, fds in CASES:
    cands, prime, nf2, nf3, bcnf, v2, v3, vb = judge(attrs, fds)
    keys = "/".join("+".join(sorted(c)) for c in cands)
    print("%-22s %-14s %-6s %-6s %-6s"
          % (name, keys, "YES" if nf2 else "NO", "YES" if nf3 else "NO", "YES" if bcnf else "NO"))
print()
for name, attrs, fds in CASES:
    cands, prime, nf2, nf3, bcnf, v2, v3, vb = judge(attrs, fds)
    print("--- %s ---" % name)
    print("  候选键   = " + "/".join("+".join(sorted(c)) for c in cands))
    print("  主属性   = " + "+".join(sorted(prime)))
    print("  违反3NF的FD = " + (", ".join(v3) if v3 else "无"))
    print("  违反BCNF的FD= " + (", ".join(vb) if vb else "无"))
    if v2:
        print("  部分依赖 = " + ", ".join(v2))
print()
print("判据: BCNF ⊂ 3NF ⊂ 2NF ⊂ 1NF (满足 BCNF 必然满足 3NF, 反之不成立)")
print("C1 说明: 主属性覆盖全部属性时, 非超键的 FD 仍可满足 3NF 但破坏 BCNF")
